description: This file defines classes related to WFA MAP TLV for agent AP MLD configuration, including classes for configuration, AP MLD, and affiliated AP, with methods for managing and serializing these structures.

classes.name: tlvAgentApMldConfiguration
classes.description: Represents the TLV configuration for agent AP MLD, managing multiple cApMld instances.

classes.name: cApMld
classes.description: Represents an AP MLD with attributes like SSID, MAC address, modes, and affiliated APs.

classes.name: cAffiliatedAp
classes.description: Represents an affiliated AP with fields for MAC address, link ID, and validity flags.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the TLV.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the TLV.

methods.name: num_ap_mld
methods.description: Returns the number of AP MLDs.

methods.name: ap_mld
methods.description: Accesses an AP MLD by index.

methods.name: create_ap_mld
methods.description: Creates a new AP MLD instance.

methods.name: add_ap_mld
methods.description: Adds an AP MLD to the configuration.

methods.name: class_swap
methods.description: Swaps byte order of class fields.

methods.name: cApMld
methods.description: Represents an AP MLD with methods for SSID, MAC address, modes, and affiliated APs.

methods.name: ap_mld_mac_addr_valid
methods.description: Returns validity info for AP MLD MAC address.

methods.name: set_ssid
methods.description: Sets SSID from string or buffer.

methods.name: class_swap
methods.description: Swaps byte order of class fields.

methods.name: cAffiliatedAp
methods.description: Represents an affiliated AP with validity flags, MAC address, link ID.
